_om: Skrønemakeren in English (Porkies, rusj.no/en/porkies/). Key = the Norwegian text in spill.js. A «skrøne» is a porky (a made-up answer); the one who fools the crew is the fibber. The cards are in data.en/kort.json, written for the UK. Shared words come from rusj/kit/tekst.en.json.
Et kort viser noe rart, men ekte. Alle d: A card shows something strange but real. Everyone makes up an answer that sounds true – then you have to find the real one.
Mobilen går rundt. Hver av dere skriver: The phone goes round. Each of you secretly writes an answer that sounds real.
Skrønene blandes med det ekte svaret. Mo: The porkies are mixed in with the real answer. The phone goes round again, and everyone votes for what they think is true.
Finner du sannheten, får du {sann} poeng: Find the truth and you get {sann} points. Every time someone falls for your porky, you get {lurt}.
Keep it short and dull – like a dictionary. The best porkies sound like something you've read somewhere.
Skriver du tilfeldigvis det ekte svaret,: If you happen to write the real answer, you get {bonus} bonus points. Then you write another porky and sit out the vote.
Like skrøner slås sammen. Stemmer noen p: Identical porkies are merged. If someone votes for one, everyone who wrote it gets points.
You can't vote for your own porky.
Kjenner noen kortet fra før? Trykk «Bytt: Does someone already know the card? Tap ‘New card’ before you start writing.
Finner dere den ekte?: Can you spot the real one?
Everyone writes and votes every round.
Les kortet høyt. Alle dikter et svar som: Read the card out loud. Everyone makes up an answer that sounds real – the real answer gets mixed in.
De andre ser bort mens du stemmer: Everyone else looks away while you vote
De andre ser bort mens du skriver: Everyone else looks away while you write
Du får {bonus} poeng i bonus. Skriv en s: You get {bonus} bonus points. Write another porky so the others have something to fall for.
Skriv et svar som høres ekte ut …: Write an answer that sounds real …

{navn} skrev det ekte svaret og får {bon.one: {navn} wrote the real answer and gets {bonus} bonus points.
{navn} skrev det ekte svaret og får {bon.other: {navn} wrote the real answer and get {bonus} bonus points each.

{navn} skrev det ekte svaret og får {bon.one: {navn} wrote the real answer and gets {bonus} bonus points – and sits out the vote.
{navn} skrev det ekte svaret og får {bon.other: {navn} wrote the real answer and get {bonus} bonus points each – and sit out the vote.

Send mobilen rundt og stem: Pass the phone round and vote
Først skrønene noen gikk på – det ekte s: First the porkies someone fell for – the real answer last.
Ingen gikk på en skrøne. Hva var det ekt: Nobody fell for a porky. What was the real answer?
Nobody fell for a porky this round.
Well done! Those porkies went down a treat.
Your porky needs letters or numbers.
Det var det ekte svaret! {bonus} poeng i: That was the real answer! {bonus} bonus points to {navn}. Write another porky.
You'll go straight to the results.
Dere går rett til kåringen. Runden dere: You'll go straight to the results. The round you're in now won't score any points.
